notes.LA24: Mid-depth DeltaNet mixer with modest out-proj top singular value 2.09 and in_norm gain mean 1.422; its SV0 target alignments are weak (|σ|<0.75), so expect small uniform damage scaled by each prompt's top-1 margin.
notes.LA25: Layer-0 mixer has the largest out-proj spectrum among DeltaNet layers (top SVs 2.48, 2.03, 1.71) and extreme dt_bias values (+8.375, -13.0625), so removing all layer-0 token mixing should badly degrade every downstream layer without fully destroying the model since the layer-0 MLP remains.
notes.LA26: Layer-21 mixer has a flat out-proj spectrum (top SV only 1.42) despite a high in_norm gain mean of 1.722, suggesting distributed, modest late-layer contributions; small negative dlogp, P6 near zero.
notes.LA27: Layer-14 MLP (down_proj top SV 1.39) hosts neuron 1438 whose write direction is anti-' Par'/' Bar' (P0/P4 ' Paris' -2.21σ), suggesting this MLP touches the Paris prediction, so P4 (margin only 0.469 vs 0.071) gets the largest hit.
notes.LA28: Layer-21 MLP contains strong number neurons: 3384 is anti-' five' (-5.61σ on P1) and 2126 is pro-'2'/anti-'three'; a late anti-five neuron may act as a calibration suppressor, so P1 damage is set smaller than the other prompts.
notes.LA29: Layer 3 is the first full-attention layer (mixer_in norm 40.50, out-proj top SV 2.02, down_proj top SV 1.46); skipping the whole block removes the earliest global token mixing, so sequence-pattern prompts P0/P1/P3 and fragile P7 suffer most.
notes.LA30: Last block: out-proj has the largest spectrum of any layer (top SVs 2.69, 2.18, 2.14, 2.09) with SV0 hitting P2 ' +' at -3.55σ, and the MLP has the largest gate_proj norm 36.18 with anti-five neuron 3051 (-6.47σ on P1); removing it shifts final logits substantially, especially for P2 and low-margin P7.
notes.LA31: Layer-5 DeltaNet block with down_proj dominated by one direction (top SV 1.57 vs 0.97 next) and out-proj SV0 aligned negatively with P0/P4/P5 targets (-1.18σ, -1.50σ); an early full block removal causes moderate damage across prompts.
notes.LA32: Layer-17 MLP (down_proj top SV 1.17) features numeric neurons 2886/2563 (anti-'3'/'4', pro-'9') and 'File'-suppressing neuron 3455, all with P0/P4 ' Paris' at -2.4σ to -2.7σ; expect modest degradation, largest for the low-margin P4.
notes.LA33: Skipping all of layer 0 (mixer plus MLP, in_norm gain mean 1.238, down_proj top SV 1.77 far above the next 1.00) leaves only raw embeddings for every later layer; this is catastrophic, so dlogp is near the floor and flips are near-certain for all prompts.
notes.LA34: Layer-18 block has the highest in_norm gain mean (1.732) and largest mixer_in norm among DeltaNets (58.91), and its down_proj SV1 is a strong ' a' vs ' the' axis (-10.1σ on 'the') with neuron 2028 at -2.73σ on ' five'; late block removal yields moderate damage, more for P1/P4.
notes.LA35: Layer-23 attention alone: out-proj SV1 is a single-letter-token direction (' t' +8.1σ) with P7 ' are' at +3.35σ and P1 ' five' at +2.36σ, while SV0 is anti-operator (P2 ' +' -3.55σ); expect moderate hits with P2 and P7 most at risk.
